nodeDrag.details: In Circular layout, vertex 0 was pressed at approximately (499,456), selection committed as vertex:0, and the held gesture visibly moved it to approximately (580,520). Moving after release did not continue drag; clicks at the moved position toggled selection off and on.

selectedPan.details: With vertex 0 selected, empty-canvas drag from (100,680) to (160,650) cleared selection and applied (+60,-30). Vertex 0 was then hit at its translated position (640,490).

unselectedPan.details: With no selection, empty-canvas drag applied a further (+40,-20). Vertex 0 was then hit at its translated position (680,470).

gestureTermination.details: After reset, an empty-canvas pan began at (100,600), moved through (80,600) and (50,600), then left horizontally at (20,600). Immediately after release outside, the graph reflected the last in-canvas -50px horizontal delta. Moving back to (100,600) with no button pressed restored the graph to its original translation, proving stateRef.current.pan remained active after the real Chromium mouseleave sequence.
gestureTermination.expected: Post-leave pointer movement without a pressed button must not change graph translation.
gestureTermination.observed: Post-leave pointer movement changed graph translation by +50px.

ringSelection.details: Clicking the visible h0 ring perimeter selected hyperedge:h0 and displayed its metadata.

nodeSelection.details: Clicking/dragging vertex 0 selected vertex:0 even where ring geometry overlapped; subsequent clicks at the moved position toggled normally.
